reason: Reviewed all five surfaces for the hub attendance fix. Lifecycle hooks: unchanged; no hook definition changes. A registration for a session the hub swept as ended now returns the existing session-ending refusal, already in the retry-later set, so the hook child retries as before and prints nothing new. CLI readiness: doctor output, setup and status are unchanged; the hub now names each session once per attendance batch, splits a refused batch into one exchange per session, sets a session refused on its own aside for ten minutes, and resets its backoff only after a successful exchange. hub.exchange log records gain refused and set-aside events with the service status, code and message; the diagnostics reference still describes hub.exchange as the hub service traffic, which stays accurate. Notifai skill and harness setup: no text or step depends on attendance retry timing. Domain terms: unchanged. skills/guidance-changes.json gains the release note for this change.
